summary:
Lambda and Lambdad are implemented with docs and tests; nothing is committed. Tests, flake8 and black were not run (per instructions), so verification is by reading only.

Changes:
- monai/transforms/utility/array.py: Lambda appended at end. Constructor asserts "func must be callable" and stores func; __call__ returns func(img).
- monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: typing import changed to "from typing import Callable, Optional" (the only removed line in the diff); Lambda added to the import list; Lambdad class placed after ConcatItemsd (copies with dict(data), applies one internal Lambda to each listed key); "LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad" appended to the alias block.
- docs/source/transforms.rst: Lambda entry before SplitChannel, Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd.
- tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py: identity and spatial-only slicing tests on NumpyImageTestCase2D; Lambdad tests cover a keys view on a sole-entry dict and explicit keys with an unlisted string entry and an unchanged original mapping.

Choices: "vanilla module" mapped to monai/transforms/utility/array.py and "dictionary module" to utility/dictionary.py, since the repo has no top-level vanilla.py or dictionary.py. The typing-line rule was read as replacing "from typing import Optional" with the Callable-added version, since Optional is still used by DataStatsd.
